title: Critique: the standard replies make predictive processing untestable

statements.text: Redefining what counts as surprising to escape the dark room risks making predictive processing untestable and explanatorily empty.

sources.locator: accepted manuscript p. 1, summarizing Sun and Firestone
sources.quote: standard responses to this challenge have the potential to render the PP account untestable and explanatorily empty
highlighting the obstacles facing 'theories-of-everything' in psychology
